assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Removing the window (mounting every row) makes mountedAtTop 1000 against MAX_MOUNTED_ROWS 150, exactly the declared mutation; the negative control log shows assert 1000 <= 0 -> 1000 <= 150 failing.
Dropping the spacers, or keying the window to the wrong offsets, stops the last row being mounted after a jump to the end, so lastRendered stops equal lastSlug (figures/0999.png).

A regression that reintroduces a main-thread task above 200 ms during load or scroll leaves a duration in loadLongTasks/scrollLongTasks and makes the missed list non-empty; the detector is proved live first, so the empty list is a measurement and not a dead observer.
